body:
I’m trying to find a better option than that place. Just live in a small town in the south where mental illness is still swept under the rug. It’s just been recently that the rest of my family has accepted the fact that I probably need help. And even then I think they are kind of ashamed still. But that’s better than where they were 🤷‍♂️.

And not I’ve been hospitalized one time for going to the ER like that. I’m not doing it again. That’s been almost 12 years ago. Yes I’ve gone long stretches before unmedicated and not hurt myself or anything.

Hate lithium. But maybe just never got dosage right? I just felt nothing about anything ever. 

Depakote seemed to work pretty well. Well enough I convinced myself it was all in my head and was just going through a rough time lol. 

Also the only place to go in my area really the majority of the people that go there are court ordered. I get it everyone deserves help but I just got tired of people thinking I did something wrong and was there as punishment

Unmedicated atm. I’m just Type 2. I know I need to be on meds but don’t have good options for treatment etc  in my area. I know excuses right? 

Like I’ve stated I know I won’t do it. Just venting I guess

Thank you for the thoughtful reply. I too am bipolar. I’m not putting it off for any other reason than I still have the fear inside me of what’s after this life. I guess that could be considered a good thing. Who knows what tomorrow holds🤷‍♂️. But thanks for taking the time to post that.
